notes: Zone polygons from the three FLEX_20260717 map layers embedded on cdta.org/flex (edited July 2026). Since mid-2026 FLEX picks up at designated stops (point to point in all zones); stops come from the 20260716_*_stops layers in the same CDTA ArcGIS account. Guilderland Town Hall runs only Thursdays 4:00 PM to 8:30 PM. Hours are per zone from cdta.org/flex (last updated 10/09/2026), not the page's generic Monday-Saturday line. No minimum age is stated. CDTA GTFS has no Flex. Left out "Excelsior Courtyard (Summer Trolley Only)": its name says it serves the summer trolley, not year-round FLEX.
